ticker_news.title: United States Podcasting Market Report 2025: Growth Trends and Opportunities to 2030 Featuring Analysis of Amazon, Apple, iHeartMedia, Pandora Media, Audacy & More
ticker_news.description: The United States podcasting market is expected to grow significantly, driven by factors like high internet penetration, smartphone adoption, and a thriving creator community. However, legal and copyright issues pose challenges. The involvement of celebrities and influencers is a key trend, boosting listenership and monetization opportunities.
